Metadata.defaultTitle: Digital Leadership Immersion — Understand technology. Lead change.
Metadata.description: A selective 16-week immersion for founders, directors and managers who need to understand technology, evaluate AI and lead their organization's digital transformation.

Footer.tagline: Understand technology. Challenge assumptions. Decide better. Lead change.

Diagnostic.title: Where does your digital judgment stand?
Diagnostic.intro: 36 scenario-based questions across 10 capabilities. There's no technical trivia here — we're evaluating your reasoning against real decisions.
